svg.aria-label: The files of a full run of the paper skill, from agent to agent. A FULL RUN: EACH AGENT AND THE FILES IT HANDS ON: Intake agent to Literature strategist (config.md); Literature strategist to Structure architect (review.md, refs.bib); Structure architect to Argument builder (outline.md); Argument builder to Draft writer (arguments.md); Argument builder to Visualization agent (arguments.md); Draft writer to Citation compliance agent (main.tex, intended-claims.md, draft-report.md); Draft writer to Abstract agent (main.tex); Visualization agent to Peer reviewer (figures/, figures.md, a patch); Citation compliance agent to Peer reviewer (citation-report.md, patches); Abstract agent to Peer reviewer (a patch); Peer reviewer to Formatter (review-<r>.md); Formatter to The manuscript's folder: main.tex, refs.bib, figures/, the PDF and the other targets (format-report.md, patches) | EVERY CHANGE AFTER THE FIRST DRAFT IS A PATCH: An agent to Script: the patch applied to the file by its block hashes (<nn>-<file name>.patch.json); Script: the patch applied to the file by its block hashes to The manuscript's folder: the changed file (the patched file); Script: the patch applied to the file by its block hashes to patches/ in the run folder: the manifest, the patch, the patched file and the apply report (the four files of the patch).
